purpose: Read the fixture rheometer's identity, state and reported ranges through mock tools, and analyse flow curves it is handed, so that a bundle with skills and subagents is exercised end to end on an instrument that does not exist.
science_task: fit a power law to a flow curve and say what the instrument reports about itself
must_not: invent a number or choose a tolerance
run a skill that changes a device

subagents.name: operator
subagents.description: Uses the hardware skills: finds and identifies the instrument, reads its state and the ranges it reports. It is the only subagent that may be given a skill that changes a device, and in this bundle it is given none.

subagents.name: analyst
subagents.description: Uses the skills that touch no device: computes bounds from the rows it is handed and fits the data it is handed.
